'''Holly Andorf''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Modesto tournament]] on 24 March 2001 with Training, according to Paul McKelvey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1948">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-modesto-california-3-24-01d1948/ modesto-california-3-24-01], DeckTech (Paul "Dark Raptor" McKelvey, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-modesto-california-3-24-01d1948/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
